scope: Original browser Opus RTP sample-clock repair; no native PTS, ACK, media framing or UI changes

verification.prior_source: Both new timing regressions fail: burst packets reuse RTP timestamps and a concurrent drop loses sampling time
verification.fixed_source: Seven WebRTC tests pass, including real loopback ICE/DTLS/SRTP; burst cadence, wraparound, real gaps and in-flight packet drop checks pass

full_backend.optional_skips: No native fixture in isolated worktree plus six optional platform checks

contract: Both native hosts encode 480-sample / 10 ms Opus packets at 48 kHz. RTP advances at least 480 samples per incoming packet; larger enqueue-time gaps remain gaps. Dropped concurrent packets consume sampling time, not sequence numbers. No queue is added.
hardware_status: Separate phone baseline has working video/touch and audible stutter. This correction has not been activated or physically tested; it does not establish the cause or resolution of that stutter.
